description: This Java class defines a Gradle task 'GenerateWordsListTask' that processes input files (HTML, HTM, TXT) to generate a words list XML file, utilizing Jsoup for HTML parsing and handling file I/O operations.

classes.name: GenerateWordsListTask
classes.description: A Gradle task class that generates a words list XML file from input HTML and text files, parsing HTML content with Jsoup, and managing file operations.

methods.name: generateWordsList
methods.description: Main task action method that processes input files, converts HTML files to text, and invokes a parser to generate the words list.

methods.name: getInputFiles
methods.description: Getter for input files array, annotated for Gradle input files.

methods.name: getOutputWordsListFile
methods.description: Getter for the output words list file, annotated as output file.

methods.name: setOutputWordsListFile
methods.description: Setter for the output words list file.

methods.name: getWordCharacters
methods.description: Getter for the array of characters considered as part of words.

methods.name: setWordCharacters
methods.description: Setter for the array of characters considered as part of words.

methods.name: getAdditionalInnerCharacters
methods.description: Getter for additional characters allowed inside words.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Getter for the locale used during parsing.

methods.name: getMaxWordFrequency
methods.description: Getter for the maximum word frequency threshold.

methods.name: setMaxWordFrequency
methods.description: Setter for the maximum word frequency threshold.

methods.name: getMaxWordsInList
methods.description: Getter for the maximum number of words in the list.

methods.name: setMaxWordsInList
methods.description: Setter for the maximum number of words in the list.
